$description: The interface's parts a theme may style on their own, and the size-neutral variants of each (theme.json `parts`). Every variant keeps the same boxes, heights and spacing; only the treatment changes. Tokens for each part: part.<name>.* in tokens.json.

variants.banner: the header.banner art behind the title, fading into the page
variants.ribbon: the kicker as a small ribbon in the room's light
variants.framed: the title in a box of its own, with an edge: for themes with a picture behind every page

variants.card: a filled card with an edge
variants.flat: no card: a hairline above each panel
variants.outlined: an edge only, the page showing through

variants.floating: a rounded bar floating above the bottom edge
a rounded bar over the page
variants.docked: a flat bar across the width, above the dock
